versionFieldNote: allowlistVersion is MACHINE-CHECKED: extraction/verify_all.py (section 4) fails if it differs from tokens/llm/component-allowlist.json's own allowlistVersion. repositoryVersion and pageSpecVersion are DOCUMENTATION-ONLY, hand-maintained markers; nothing in verify_all.py checks them (the schema separately pins pageSpecVersion via const).

sourceProject.description: React 18.3.1 + react-dom 18.3.1 + Vite 5.4.21 + Tailwind 3.4.19 clone (gsap 3.15.0, lottie-web 5.13.0, typed.js 2.1.0, p5 1.9.0) of the real, live marketing site https://www.datashake.com/. Single-page source: exactly one route ('/'). Not a git repository.
sourceProject.note: SNAPSHOT of the source project at build time, not a living mirror. Re-diff versions and claims if the source changes.

countsNote: Every value in counts is recomputed from the files on disk by extraction/verify_all.py (section 6) on every run; a hand-bumped or stale number fails verification. sections = 14 distinct section components + the LinesDivider; templateSlots = 14 section slots + 10 page-level divider slots.

licensing.summary: Real third-party logos, real testimonials, a paid licensed heading font (Altriviera), a HubSpot form (replaced by a placeholder) and real datashake.com links. See README 'Real-company and licensing rules' and tokens/llm/component-allowlist.json assetRoles.

entryPointsNote: Every path resolves to a real file INSIDE this design-repo folder (verify_all.py section 8 also fails if a shipped file is missing from this list). External evidence (src/, public/, tailwind.config.cjs, CLONE_SPEC*.md, the saved Webflow export) is cited only in extraction/measured-values.json, which degrades to warnings when no sibling source tree is present.
packaging: design-repo.zip (sibling of this folder) is a build artifact regenerated fresh and last; gitignore it if the project is ever put under version control.
